Monster from Diablo II Resurrected. 20 different poses with some additional weapon options, including Shadowfang to portray Fleshdoom from the first game's cut content (later reintroduced by mods like Belzebub).
Also includes some massive axe wielding specimen in case you wanted a proxy for a certain notorious bloodthirsty demon.

Each pose has a wingless version and there are four different separate wings provided, each with two attachment angle options. Beware, the fit of separate wings is going to be loose and fiddly, with lots of sanding and gap filling. For a larger print I strongly suggest pinning the wings as well.

Separate armored codpiece is supplied as well.

Addon for my hell infantry set:
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/doom-hell-infantry-eternal

Vest is edited to remove rifle ammo pouches. which would make little sense for machinegunners.

Ammo belts are intended to be glued onto a strip of thick paper and then shaped by breaking the links between individual bullets as needed. Two variants of different thickness provided, to make the links breakable at different scales. Let me know how it goes. :)

Two arms posed to hold the ammo belt feeding the minigun are also provided.

I have aso built a minigun backpack from scratch. It has a version without the tubes and handle, if you want to make those out of wire instead.

And yes, bald head and facial hair are mandatory for UAC heavy weapon operators.

Monster from Diablo II Resurrected. Twelve different poses plus one dead specimen. Four different weapons. Some poses used for both slashing and stabbing attacks. Some wear bone talismans. Armbands are separate meshes and can be removed for added variety. Same for individual clumps of fur.

Sadly there are no animations usable for one-handed weapons or bows like they had in the first Diablo.

Goatman fur just chokes my computer. These have been rather aggressively decimated and they are still over 100 MB each. If you want more detailed version, I'm also releasing a .blend file with animations to export your own minis:
